Specifically: qualitative research methods to uncover granular customer avatars beyond superficial demographic labels, identifying past failed solutions, day-to-day functional friction, lost identity markers, broken trust markers, and verbatim language patterns mined from 1-star competitor reviews, condition-specific Reddit communities, Shopify post-purchase surveys, and direct customer phone calls.

why: Research mechanics for extracting hyper-specific buyer vocabulary, past failed attempts, and broken trust markers from 1-star reviews and niche forums to replace broad demographic profiles.
topics: [research method, review mining, objection discovery, avatar record structure]

research method / conducting direct customer phone interviews at scale, implementing Shopify post-purchase surveys, and mining condition-specific Reddit forums. review mining / extracting broken trust markers, mechanical product flaws, and exhausted claims from competitor 1-star reviews. objection discovery / identifying previous failed solutions (e.g., physical therapy), recurring venting topics, and skepticism toward repeated industry claims. avatar record structure / cataloging exact vernacular differences across age cohorts, restricted lifestyle activities (e.g., sports, hobbies), and specific procedural vocabulary (e.g., patellar tendon graft).

Review-mining mechanics: isolating 1-star reviews on competitor listings to catalog explicit failure points, broken trust markers, and physical friction (e.g., "couldn't get the brace off fast enough"). Language collection protocol: capturing exact phrasing, syntax, and clinical or subculture terminology directly from customer vents rather than marketing brainstorming. Sourcing routine: deploying automated Shopify post-purchase surveys and running continuous phone outreach to existing buyers to extract unvarnished day-to-day lifestyle limitations (e.g., inability to participate in a defining hobby).

Skip. Persona templates with demographic fields and no job (e.g., generic profiles like "30+ year old woman with knee pain"). Broad demographic segmentations lacking specific situational context or failed past attempts. Creative ad execution details, such as hook writing, visual scripting, or landing page design, which belong downstream in application modules.
Scope mix. The method is universal, so there is a real baseline here: every avatar must have quoted evidence, a trigger moment, and a job statement. The number of avatars is not universal.
